official_definition: Draw a card. Then, you can send a core from any of your Contract Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit. When you've done so, if it's the opposing Attack Step, during this battle, the effects of an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus can't activate, and when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Contract Unleash] or [Contract Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Contract Unleash]", "give [Contract Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
